title: InputManifest
description: Schema for the base worker input manifest. Defines the contract for requests submitted to the barclays-buk-data-engineer agent, covering task type, problem context, supplied artefacts, and all optional domain-specific parameters.

task_type.description: The type of task the agent is being asked to perform.

problem_statement.description: A clear description of the problem or goal this request is addressing.

desired_outputs.description: List of artefact types or deliverables expected from the agent.

target_environment.description: The target environment for the work (e.g. dev, test, prod).

supplied_artifacts.description: Artefacts provided as input to the agent for context or processing.

path.description: File path or URI to the artefact.

type.description: Artefact type identifier (e.g. ddl, mapping, sample_data).

description.description: Human-readable description of the artefact and its relevance.

authorised_context_sources.description: List of context source identifiers the agent is permitted to consult.

constraints.description: Explicit constraints the agent must respect when producing outputs.

requester.description: Identity of the person or system submitting this request.

business_outcome.description: The business outcome or value proposition this request is intended to achieve.

acceptance_criteria.description: Conditions that must be met for the outputs to be considered acceptable.

functional_requirements.description: Functional requirements relevant to this request.

non_functional_requirements.description: Non-functional requirements relevant to this request (e.g. performance, security).

source_systems.description: Identifiers of source systems involved in this request.

target_systems.description: Identifiers of target systems involved in this request.

source_to_target_mapping.description: File path or URI to an existing source-to-target mapping document.

sample_data_reference.description: Reference to sample data relevant to this request.

data_classification.description: Data classification level applicable to the data in scope (e.g. public, internal, confidential, restricted).

data_product_type.description: Type of data product being engineered (e.g. source-aligned, aggregate, consumer-aligned).

expected_velocity.description: Expected data velocity or ingestion frequency (e.g. 'batch daily', 'streaming 10k/s').

retention_objective.description: Data retention objective (e.g. '7 years', '90 days hot + 5 years cold').

recovery_objective.description: Recovery time or point objective (e.g. 'RPO 1 hour, RTO 4 hours').

approved_technology_candidates.description: List of pre-approved technology candidates eligible for selection.

platform_constraints.description: Platform-level constraints or mandates that must be observed.

lineage_references.description: References to existing lineage documents or lineage system records.

existing_models.description: References to existing logical or physical data models relevant to this request.

security_references.description: References to security standards, policies, or controls applicable to this request.

cost_constraints.description: Cost constraints or budget considerations relevant to technology or design decisions.

migration_strategy.description: High-level migration strategy if this request involves data migration.

repository_reference.description: URI or identifier of the source code repository associated with this request.

branch_reference.description: Branch name within the repository relevant to this request.

named_approvers.description: Map of approval role to named individual required for sign-off.
